notes: ABOUT, ROUND ONE. Compared against the approved design property by property and word by word, not by eye.

THE WRITING IS YOURS, VERBATIM. Ours had grown a third longer — an extra clause in the opening, a list of gadget examples, a sentence about enthusiasts, and a catalogue of Runes inside the paragraph that explains what a Rune is.
THE DIAGRAM IS BACK: one card called out of a panel, arrow, "ONE RUNE — switch it off and the panel closes up around it." The design closes About with it; we had nothing.

The panel's Name reads as a value on the right of its row, in mono, like the Rune count and version under it — not as a text box. It is still editable; the design simply never drew the moment you are editing it.

⚠️ EVERY ON/OFF IN THE EDITOR IS A PILL SWITCH NOW. The design does not use a checkbox anywhere, and I had never compared the CONTROLS — only the type and the structure. Sliders are native ranges tinted gold; selects and text fields carry…
